name: web_fetch
description: Fetch an https URL as markdown (HTML, PDF, Office, text); robots.txt is honoured. Long documents come back in windows (continue from `offset`). With `prompt`, only its answer from the page comes back. A redirect to another host is returned, not followed.

name: web_search
description: Search the web. Returns a short answer and the sources it cites, with URLs; use `web_fetch` to read a source in full.
